title: I spent a year making a free 3D card game inspired by Yu-Gi-Oh, Hearthstone and Pokémon TCG Pocket. It's now in Open Alpha!
author: Kajamaz
selftext:
I started this game project over a year ago knowing I was in over my head trying to make something that could stand next to Hearthstone, MTG Arena, Pokémon Pocket or Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links.

I wanted to mix the parts I love most from each one: a mana system like Hearthstone and Pokémon Pocket, an Extra Deck and special summons like Yu-Gi-Oh, and progression like MTG Arena.

Happy to announce the game is finally in open alpha and anyone can play! The Steam page goes live soon too, i'm excited (steam's approval system takes so so long)!

It's completely free to play, and it will never be pay to win: [https://kajamaz.itch.io/riftaria](https://kajamaz.itch.io/riftaria)

I'd love to hear what you guys think, and am open to feedback and suggestions!
